warnings: Monophonic: every chord becomes a fast arpeggio, because each new note cuts off the last.
Notes ring for 10s but land every 476ms, so this will sound muddy.
Dense passages plus long sustain means a lot of overlap.
14 notes would not sound on this Shawzin.

suggestions.name: Tiamat Shawzin
suggestions.timbre: Bass guitar - low register, slap instead of chords
reasons: A reasonable general-purpose choice for this arrangement.
warnings: Monophonic: every chord becomes a fast arpeggio, because each new note cuts off the last.
Notes ring for 10s but land every 476ms, so this will sound muddy.
Dense passages plus long sustain means a lot of overlap.
Bass register: this will sound an octave lower than written.
Combined frets slap the note rather than playing a chord, so the harmony in this arrangement will not sound.
14 notes would not sound on this Shawzin.
